newsitem.title: USA: Hormel Foods places $100 mln in notes.
newsitem.headline: Hormel Foods places $100 mln in notes.

text.p: Hormel Foods Corp said Friday that it completed a private placement of senior notes in the amount of $110 million.
The senior notes will mature October 15, 2002, and October 15, 2006.

Hormel, which processes and markets consumer-branded meat and food products, said proceeds from the private placement will be used for a meat products and foodservice processing plant and distribution center under construction in Osceola, Iowa.
Proceeds also will be used for other general corporate purposes.

"This now-completed financing package will enable the company to continue its aggressive building program and to take advantage of internal or external expansion opportunities that may arise in the future," V. Allan Krejci, director of public relations, said in a statement.

Hormel said the notes were placed with the Lutheran Brotherhood of Minneapolis, Metropolitan Life Insurance Co, Nationwide Life Insurance Co, Principal Mutual Life Insurance Co and TMG Life Insurance Co.
